name: Herds-custom_is_milking
description: Check if this herd contains milking cows (lactating groups)
label: Is Milking Herd

name: Herds-custom_is_calf_rearing
description: Tick if this herd contains calves on milk feeding (e.g. 0-2 months). Calf Feeding events validate that the calf's current herd has this flag set.
label: Is Calf-Rearing Herd

name: Herds-custom_production_group
description: Maps this herd to a production group for KPI tracking (matches Excel tracker Group 1/2/3)
label: Production Group

name: Herds-custom_is_dry
description: Tick if this herd contains dry cows or steaming-up cows. Excluded from milk recording.
label: Is Dry / Pre-calving Herd

name: Herds-custom_herd_category
description: Herd category for KPI grouping: Milking, Dry, Youngstock
label: Herd Category

name: Herds-custom_feed_account
description: Expense account for feed costs for this herd. Overrides the global setting in Livestock Settings.
label: Feed Expense Account (override)

name: Herds-custom_vet_account
description: Expense account for vet/drug costs for this herd. Overrides the global setting.
label: Vet / Drug Expense Account (override)

name: Herds-custom_cost_center
description: Cost centre for this herd. All JEs for events, feed, vet costs, and milk for this herd use this cost centre. Pulled from Livestock Settings if not set.
label: Cost Center
